title: Houthis used Anthropic AI to try to build ballistic missiles

reading.body:
This incident cannot be summarized. The only source reporting it is paywalled, and its full content is not available. The headline alone does not establish what actually occurred, what Anthropic's system was asked to do, whether it complied, or what safeguards failed or functioned as intended.

It is not established whether this represents a failure of the AI system, the access controls around it, the usage policies, or some combination of these. It is also not established what the Houthis actually accomplished or attempted to accomplish with any assistance they may have received.
